target: target area price minus previous-day same-slot price

ridge.scaling: fit on each training window only

training_labels: prior delivery-day auction prices, already cleared under Stage4 timing assumptions
postprocessing: none; negative predictions retained and counted
selection_policy: fixed algorithms/parameters; no search or tuning using the evaluation period
limitations: July-November baseline period was already inspected in Stage4; this is reused retrospective evaluation, not untouched prospective testing
12h weather availability assumption; historical first-availability unverified
No holiday table, regional pre-auction demand/renewable forecasts, interconnectors, outages or fuel features

gates.model_candidate: at least 5% MAE reduction versus previous-day in every area
gates.weather_increment: at least 5% MAE gain in >=2 areas, no area degrades >2%, and paired 95% block-bootstrap upper bound <0 in every area
gates.monthly_stability: at least 3 of 4 full months improve versus previous-day in every area
gates.deployment: also requires verified source timing and 30 consecutive prospective delivery days; retrospective results alone cannot open platform deployment gate
